Game Overview

Mini Arrows puts players into a retro experience centered on guide a charming slime through vibrant, puzzle-filled realms by toggling directional arrows. As the slime moves autonomously, strategize to guide it past obstacles, avoid perilous traps, and reach magical portals. Immerse yourself in this delightful mix of quick reflexes and thoughtful planning as you navigate each captivating level.
